**/*disabled: Files explicitly disabled at build time are not part of a published runtime.
**/deprecated: Legacy compatibility sources in deprecated directories are outside the current published entrypoint surface.
**/wip/**: Work-in-progress sources are not exported by published packages.
**/libs/**: Vendored third-party library sources are tested through their owning adapters.
**/test/**: Test support code is not production source.
**/*.d.ts: TypeScript declarations contain no executable statements.
**/bundle.+(js|ts): Generated bundle entrypoints are covered through their source modules.
**/*.worker.+(js|ts): Worker entrypoints execute in separate worker coverage contexts and contain only generated dispatch wiring.
**/text-encoding.js: Vendored text-encoding implementation is exercised through the polyfill adapter.
**/encoding.js: Vendored encoding implementation is exercised through the polyfill adapter.
**/laz-perf.js: Generated laz-perf WASM glue is covered through LAS backend conformance tests.
**3d-tiles/src/styles/**: Unexported legacy Cesium style-port sources are not part of the current package surface.
**/src/flatgeobuf/**: Generated and vendored FlatGeobuf implementation code is covered through the public loader adapter.
modules/traces/src/otlp-proto/generated/: Generated OpenTelemetry protobuf descriptors are covered through the public OTLP loaders and writers.
modules/worker-utils/src/lib/process-uti: The proxy runs only inside a spawned child process whose V8 coverage is not observable by the parent test process.
